cc:Work.dc:title: Redistribute first, then trade
cc:Work.dc:description: At prices (1,1), wealth falls from 6 to 4 for Alice and rises from 2 to 4 for Benjamin. One redistribution is omega-prime=(2.5,1.5) each; trade along the new budget takes Alice to E=(3,1).
